svg.title: Responsible AI Implementation Checklist
svg.desc: Flow. Identify the use case, then ask whether it is high risk: health, finance, HR or legal. If yes, it requires human review plus compliance sign-off. If no, it follows standard deployment. Both paths then define a governance policy, document AI usage for employees, establish a feedback and incident channel, and finish with a quarterly AI council review.
svg.text: Verify these before deploying any AI solution. High-risk use cases get an extra gate.
